title: THE MAP STORY ON A LORE CARD
why: His order of 2026-10-09: the raid text reads like a shooter HUD, and a found document opens as a card you can read. The map story was said as one message row of about 250 characters, which the row cut at two lines, so most of it was never read. It now shows on a card left of centre above the tactical belt: its name as an amber caps title and the whole text wrapped under it, for 14 seconds or until you walk 300 away. It hides under an alert or the use bar and never goes into the message feed.
now: The story you find on each map now opens as a readable card instead of a cut-off message line.

edits.replacement:
locTick(dt);   // v22.xx (R34): the location tag
  loreTick(dt);   // v22.xx (R39): the map story card
